record.name: Uber Mission Bay 1
record.summary: The eleven-story tower at 1455 Third Street, part of the Uber headquarters campus designed by SHoP Architects (per ArchDaily) and developed by a joint venture of Alexandria Real Estate Equities (51 percent) and Uber (49 percent) formed in September 2014; the Department of Building Inspection shows its new-construction permit completed on 2021-04-01, and Uber confirmed in October 2023 that OpenAI is leasing 1455 and 1515 Third Street from it.

changes.text: OpenAI was shown as open at 1455 3rd St on the strength of a 2023 SF Standard report of a signed lease; it now shows the tenant as announced with no opening date. Uber was shown as open since June 2020 based only on a DataSF business registration that predates the building's completion, at a building later subleased to OpenAI; that tenant listing was removed, and the related timeline entry now describes it as a registration. The completion milestone said June 2021 with only a website's home page as its source; ArchDaily gives 2022, so it now reads 2022 (the status notes say the same, and that the Assessor has no year built). A pile-driver milestone sourced only to a website's home page was removed. The joint venture (Alexandria 51%, Uber 49%, formed September 2014) now cites Alexandria's 3Q14 supplemental, which also calls the two buildings Class A. The OpenAI lease milestone cites the SF Standard and Real Deal articles.

open_questions: Parcel 8721035 first appears on the Assessor roll for 2023 with the same location as lot 8721033 (rolls to 2022) and a lot area of 38,459 sq ft; the permits are filed under lot 033. No source read explains the lot merger, so the permit and 2021 year-built evidence is attached to this record through the shared 1455 3rd St address.

The map note's 486,600 sq ft combined OpenAI sublease figure and 'largest SF office lease since 2018' (The Real Deal) could not be opened (HTTP 403); the San Francisco Standard says only 'nearly a half-million square feet' and 'largest office lease in San Francisco since 2018'.

No source read gives a groundbreaking date or an opening or move-in month; the Department of Building Inspection completed date is a permit closeout date. SocketSite (2016) expected occupancy by mid-2018; the permit shows 2021.
Sources disagree on stories (11 on the Assessor roll, 12 proposed on the permit, eleven in ArchDaily).

record.notes: Uber Mission Bay 1, 1455 3rd St -- an 11-story Class A office tower developed by a joint venture of Alexandria Real Estate Equities (51%) and Uber Technologies (49%), formed in September 2014 per Alexandria's 3Q14 supplemental, designed by SHoP Architects, part of Uber's four-building Mission Bay headquarters campus (ArchDaily lists the project as 2022; the Assessor gives no year built for this parcel). Subleased to OpenAI along with 1515 3rd St in an October 2023 deal (~486,600 sq ft combined), reported as the largest SF office lease since 2018.
